3: ===================

5: .. module:: django.db.models.options

10: The model ``_meta`` API is at the core of the Django ORM. It enables other
11: parts of the system such as lookups, queries, forms, and the admin to
12: understand the capabilities of each model. The API is accessible through
13: the ``_meta`` attribute of each model class, which is an instance of an
14: ``django.db.models.options.Options`` object.
15: 
16: Methods that it provides can be used to:
17: 
18: * Retrieve all field instances of a model
19: * Retrieve a single field instance of a model by name
20: 
21: .. versionchanged:: 1.8
22: 
23:     The Model ``_meta`` API has always existed as a Django internal, but
24:     wasn't formally documented and supported. As part of the effort to
25:     make this API public, some of the already existing API entry points
26:     have changed slightly. A :ref:`migration guide <migrating-old-meta-api>`
27:     has been provided to assist in converting your code to use the new,
28:     official API.
29:

31: 
32: Field access API
33: ================
34: 
35: Retrieving a single field instance of a model by name
36: ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
37: 
38: .. method:: Options.get_field(field_name)
39: 
40:     Returns the field instance given a name of a field.
41: 
42:     ``field_name`` can be the name of a field on the model, a field
43:     on an abstract or inherited model, or a field defined on another
44:     model that points to the model. In the latter case, the ``field_name``
45:     will be the ``related_name`` defined by the user or the name automatically
46:     generated by Django itself.
47: 
48:     :attr:`Hidden fields <django.db.models.Field.hidden>` cannot be retrieved
49:     by name.
50: 
51:     If a field with the given name is not found a
52:     :class:`~django.core.exceptions.FieldDoesNotExist` exception will be
53:     raised.
54:

57:         >>> from django.contrib.auth.models import User

59:         # A field on the model

62: 
63:         # A field from another model that has a relation with the current model
64:         >>> User._meta.get_field('logentry')
65:         <ManyToOneRel: admin.logentry>
66: 
67:         # A non existent field
68:         >>> User._meta.get_field('does_not_exist')
69:         Traceback (most recent call last):
70:             ...
71:         FieldDoesNotExist: User has no field named 'does_not_exist'
72: 
73:     .. deprecated:: 1.8
74: 
75:         :meth:`Options.get_field()` previously accepted a ``many_to_many``
76:         parameter which could be set to ``False`` to avoid searching
77:         ``ManyToManyField``\s. The old behavior has been preserved for
78:         backwards compatibility; however, the parameter and this behavior
79:         has been deprecated.
80: 
81:         If you wish to filter out ``ManyToManyField``\s, you can inspect the
82:         :attr:`Field.many_to_many <django.db.models.Field.many_to_many>`
83:         attribute after calling ``get_field()``.
84:

89: 
90:     .. versionadded:: 1.8
